items.q: Can I request a custom software project now?
items.a: Yes. Send us your requirements through the contact form. We review feasibility and send you a written proposal.

items.q: How much does a custom project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope. Small automations can start at a few thousand dollars; larger applications are priced after discovery. You always receive the price before work starts.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Simple automations often take two to four weeks. Web and mobile applications usually take one to four months, depending on features.

items.q: Can my application have different user panels?
items.a: Yes. Owner, manager and employee panels can be included, each with its own permissions.

items.q: Do you work with marketplace APIs?
items.a: Yes, through official APIs and permitted access methods. Each integration is reviewed against the platform's rules before it is included in a proposal.
The crosslisting system and the lot analysis tool are in development. You can join the waiting list on the products page.

items.a: Code ownership and licensing are defined in the proposal. In most custom projects, the client receives full ownership after final payment.

items.q: Can you improve an existing application?

items.q: Do you work with clients outside the United States?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients worldwide and communicate in English and Turkish.

cases.title: eBay listing preparation
cases.summary: Turn product notes into draft titles, descriptions and item specifics for review.
cases.challenge: Writing eBay listings one by one is slow, and item specifics are easy to miss.
cases.approach: An automation reads your product notes or spreadsheet and prepares structured drafts, so your team only reviews and approves.

cases.title: Poshmark resale workflows
cases.summary: Organize apparel details and prepare listings for Poshmark and other channels.
cases.challenge: Apparel needs sizes, brands, conditions and measurements; retyping them is slow.
cases.approach: A structured intake form collects apparel details once and prepares drafts for each channel within platform rules.

cases.title: Amazon catalog preparation
cases.summary: Organize product data and check required fields before a listing workflow.
cases.challenge: Missing or inconsistent fields cause rejected listings and lost time.
cases.approach: A validation tool checks your product data against the fields you need and highlights what is missing before upload.

cases.title: Walmart inventory workflows
cases.summary: Track stock and product data for Walmart Marketplace through permitted access.
cases.challenge: Keeping stock and product data aligned across channels is hard to do by hand.
cases.approach: A web dashboard brings stock and product data together and flags differences that need action.

cases.title: Etsy product descriptions
cases.summary: Prepare clear product descriptions without inventing materials or origin.
cases.challenge: Good descriptions sell, but writing them for every item is time-consuming.
cases.approach: A drafting tool builds descriptions only from the facts you provide, ready for you to edit and approve.

cases.title: B-Stock lot evaluation
cases.summary: Compare a lot's price with estimated fees, logistics and resale value.
cases.challenge: A lot can look cheap until fees, shipping and unsellable items are counted.
cases.approach: A calculator combines purchase price, fees, logistics and your resale assumptions into one clear estimate.

cases.title: Liquidation.com bid planning
cases.summary: Estimate net outcomes before deciding how much to bid.
cases.challenge: Bidding on a liquidation lot without a maximum price makes it easy to overpay.
cases.approach: A planning tool calculates a suggested maximum bid from your target margin and cost assumptions.

cases.title: Returns reserve
cases.summary: Include an adjustable allowance for returns when evaluating resale economics.
cases.challenge: Returns reduce real profit, but they are often left out of calculations.
cases.approach: Your analysis tool includes a configurable returns reserve based on category or your own history.

cases.title: Shipping cost estimates
cases.summary: Account for weight, dimensions and shipping options in your planning.
cases.challenge: Shipping costs vary widely and can turn a profitable item into a loss.
cases.approach: A planning tool estimates shipping costs from weight and dimensions and includes them in each calculation.

cases.title: Owner overview
cases.summary: A single panel with the business information and controls an owner needs.
cases.challenge: Owners often collect numbers from many places to understand how the business is doing.
cases.approach: An owner dashboard shows key figures, users and settings in one secure place.

cases.title: Manager coordination
cases.summary: A workspace for assigning tasks and keeping track of operations.
cases.challenge: Without one shared view, tasks get lost between messages and spreadsheets.
cases.approach: A manager workspace lets managers assign work, set priorities and see progress in real time.

cases.title: Employee task panels
cases.summary: Show every employee exactly the tasks and information they need.
cases.challenge: Employees lose time searching for instructions or asking what to do next.
cases.approach: A simple mobile panel lists each person's tasks with the details needed to complete them.

cases.title: Stock intake
cases.summary: Record incoming goods and organize what is needed for resale.
cases.challenge: Items that are not recorded on arrival are hard to find, price and list later.
cases.approach: A mobile intake app records items with barcode, photos, condition and location as they arrive.

cases.title: Product photography tasks
cases.summary: Coordinate product photos and listing preparation in one flow.
cases.challenge: Photos taken on different phones end up scattered and unlabeled.
cases.approach: A mobile workflow links each photo set to the right product and marks it ready for listing.

cases.title: CSV preparation
cases.summary: Convert agreed spreadsheet formats into clean, structured data.
cases.challenge: Supplier and marketplace files rarely use the same columns or formats.
cases.approach: An automation maps, cleans and validates spreadsheet data into the exact format you need.

cases.title: Custom reporting
cases.summary: Reports built around the metrics and data sources you choose.
cases.challenge: Standard reports rarely answer the questions that matter to your business.
cases.approach: We build reports from your own data sources, delivered as dashboards or scheduled e-mails.

cases.title: Notification bots
cases.summary: Automatic alerts and reminders through the channels your team already uses.
cases.challenge: Important changes are noticed too late when someone has to check manually.
cases.approach: A bot watches the events you care about and sends a message the moment action is needed.

cases.title: Mobile operations tools
cases.summary: Mobile workflows for tasks your team performs away from a desk.
cases.challenge: Paper notes and messages from the floor are slow and error-prone.
cases.approach: A mobile app turns field work into structured steps that update your systems immediately.

cases.title: Web-based workspaces
cases.summary: Bring selected workflows into one browser-based application.
cases.challenge: Work spread across many tools and files is hard to manage and to secure.
cases.approach: A web workspace brings the most important workflows together, with access for each role.

cases.title: Cross-channel planning
cases.summary: Plan inventory across several sales channels after reviewing API access.
cases.challenge: Selling on several marketplaces multiplies the work of keeping everything in sync.
cases.approach: We review each platform's API access and rules, then design an automation that keeps channels aligned.
